# EXP1 - Unified GEVIS question/evidence probes
Same input and selected sensor; the same hybrid evidence is queried by explicitly mapped operations. This is NOT proof of learned question semantics. No independent truth means no accuracy/F1.

## Shared current GEVIS checkpoint

Reuse matching STEP1/2 weights. STEP3 trains and validates the existing answer heads, then saves full GEVIS. Restart this EXP kernel and Run All; no GEVIS training, backup search or numerical fallback occurs here.

Learned answers, numerical discovery and held-out suffix forecasting are distinct evaluations. Checkpoint option text/order is used exactly. Original unlabelled predictions have no accuracy/F1 without independent truth.

## Scope and history

Retired bundles are under `backup/artifacts/` and are not loaded automatically. Model softmax is not a calibrated fault probability. Historical discovery results do not measure the trained answer decoder.

# EXP3 - Paired baselines against unified GEVIS
The primary method is GEVIS_shared_evidence_discovery. Exact same held-out inputs; no Test calibration. Answer-head-only predictions are an optional ablation, disabled by default.

## Shared current GEVIS checkpoint

Reuse matching STEP1/2 weights. STEP3 trains and validates the existing answer heads, then saves full GEVIS. Restart this EXP kernel and Run All; no GEVIS training, backup search or numerical fallback occurs here.

Learned answers, numerical discovery and held-out suffix forecasting are distinct evaluations. Checkpoint option text/order is used exactly. Original unlabelled predictions have no accuracy/F1 without independent truth.

GEVIS_learned_answer uses the saved STEP3 decoder on every sensor of the exact same windows as the baselines. Its maximum Yes probability uses the same Validation controls as other scored methods, never Test. GEVIS_shared_evidence_discovery, when available, is a separate numerical detector, not the trained decoder. Sparse controls do not establish matched true fault FPR.

## Scope and history

Retired bundles are under `backup/artifacts/` and are not loaded automatically. Model softmax is not a calibrated fault probability. Historical discovery results do not measure the trained answer decoder.

# EXP4 - Same GEVIS on external processes (PEALD example)
Same frozen encoder/fusion, hybrid decision and temporal localization. Threshold values are prepared from external reference/Validation inputs with the SAME algorithm and budget, never copied from CVD or fitted on Test. Original predictions and synthetic injection metrics are separate. Unsupported is NOT normal. This is calibrated transfer, not a proven zero-shot fault detector.

## One frozen GEVIS, two separate reports

Run STEP3 preparation once, then use the same frozen hybrid GEVIS here. No answer-only decoder or external weight training is required in default discovery mode.

1. Original PEALD inputs: predictions and answer coverage, without accuracy/F1 unless independent truth exists.
2. Synthetic injections: detection metrics and observable miss stages. Original controls remain unlabelled, not verified normal.

The final diagnostic cell can analyze an existing REPORT without rerunning inference. It never changes thresholds or fits on Test.

## 실행 범위
이 노트북은 오프라인 PEALD CSV 전처리 후, 고정 모델 추론을 실행합니다. 원본을 수정하거나 업로드하지 않습니다.
PEALD STEP 1/2 재학습은 필요하지 않습니다. 공정 인코더는 SOURCE_ENCODER_STEP으로 결과를 보기 전에 정합니다.
기본값 None은 PECVD manifest의 첫 인코더를 고정 사용합니다. 최고 외부 성능으로 인코더를 고르지 않습니다.
원본 가중치·manifest가 없으면 NOT_EVALUATED입니다. 지원하지 못하는 짧은 공정은 제외 사유를 따로 표시합니다.
